en: Sepia-toned historical street scene showing a wide, tree-lined avenue with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. Multi‑story buildings line the right side, while on the left there are trees, a fence, and a building with a pointed roof and a tower spire visible in the background. The printed captions at the top read "Bautzen." on the left and "Löbauerstrasse" on the right, indicating the location and street name.
